observations.summary: Poll-time focus restore can scroll the page
observations.recommendation: Scope: instance. renderKeepingFoldFocus in public/ui.js calls b.focus() with no options, and focus() scrolls its target into view. An operator who tabbed to a fold toggle and then scrolled away with the wheel or touch would be pulled back to that toggle on each 30-second poll. b.focus({ preventScroll: true }) restores focus without moving the viewport.
